refinements.outcome: Completed inventory service, contract, Postman, and Admin Web work remain historical; the remaining Admin Mobile parity Task is the only dispatchable leaf.
refinements.context: The Epic coordinates historical evidence plus the open mobile consumer without rewriting Done descriptions.

refinements.actor: ViStay implementation engineer or release operator
refinements.outcome: Admin Mobile lets an authorized booking agent inspect exact-unit availability and create or release operator-owned blocks using the same revisions, partitions, and stable failures as Admin Web.
refinements.context: Inventory APIs and Web workspace are complete. Reuse the shared client and existing mobile shell; do not recompute availability or expose booking/guest/commercial fields.
inScope: Add Inventory navigation and a touch-first property/date filter for a 1..31 local-calendar-day half-open window.
Show revision-consistent availability, authoritative branch/membership version, active/history blocks, and block detail.
Create MAINTENANCE/CLEANING/OWNER_USE/MANUAL blocks with 10..1000 character reason, correlation ID, idempotency key, and latest revision; release only TENTATIVE/ACTIVE operator-owned blocks.
Refresh after resume/network recovery and on conflict; cover loading, empty, forbidden, dependency, stale revision, conflict, success, and read-only source states.
outOfScope: Runtime business logic owned by another repository.
Production secrets or unapproved policy values.
Changing historical Jira workflow or bypassing the catalog readiness gate.
interfaces: Version every externally consumed operation or event and state its owner, caller, compatibility rule, timeout, and stable error behavior.
Keep fixtures deterministic and free of production credentials or customer data.
dataOwnership: This task owns only the named contract, UI, or infrastructure artifacts; authoritative domain rows remain in their service database.
stateMachine: Artifact lifecycle is DRAFT -> VALIDATED -> PUBLISHED; an incompatible semantic change requires a new version.
A failed validation remains unpublished and produces an actionable diagnostic.
Rollback selects the last validated artifact and does not mutate its contents.

dataPartitions: SYSTEM contract catalogue or the explicit ADMIN SITE/BRANCH partition used by the tested operation.
fieldGroups: SUMMARY by default; DOCUMENT, PII, and INTERNAL_AUDIT appear only in explicitly granted test cases.

failureSemantics: Fail validation or startup when a required contract, environment value, or dependency is absent.
Never print tokens, presigned URLs, private document fields, or production values in test output.
Use stable assertion messages so a weak agent can locate the failing contract or scenario.
idempotencyConcurrency: Fixtures use unique deterministic business keys and cleanup is safe to repeat.
Repeated publication of identical canonical input produces the same fingerprint.
Concurrent API examples assert one effect or an explicit conflict.

acceptanceCriteria.given: an authorized agent with current branch membership selects a valid unit/date range
acceptanceCriteria.when: availability loads and an allowed create/release completes
acceptanceCriteria.then: the workspace shows the new authoritative revision and correct half-open occupancy without guest/commercial data

acceptanceCriteria.given: BOOKING/CHANNEL/history source, missing grant, stale membership, offline/resumed app, or dependency failure
acceptanceCriteria.then: the action is absent/disabled or fails closed and refresh is required before retry
the app shows sanitized actionable feedback, refreshes authoritative data, and never silently submits a second mutation

tests: Run every exact command listed in testCases from the repository root.
Attach the machine-readable report plus a short mapping from each AC ID to its evidence.
Repeat the deterministic validation or flow and confirm no duplicate effect.

testCases.command: manual: run Android debug build against local full Compose and execute the checked-in inventory fixture flow
testCases.evidence: Android device screenshots/video plus fixture IDs and API correlation IDs

observability: Test output includes correlation ID and stable error code but no secrets or protected field values.
Operational artifacts include readiness/failure evidence and a rollback or cleanup note.
definitionOfDone: All named artifacts exist and repository CI passes.
Compatibility, authorization-negative, repeatability, and cleanup/rollback evidence are attached.
Catalog and Jira are synchronized and a selected DryRun returns zero changes.
